H=W=20
r0,r1,c0,c1=2,8,9,15
markers=[(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]
g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
for r in range(r0,r1+1):
 for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r][c]=2
# row extensions from rectangle, blocked if any marker on that row on the corresponding side
for r in range(r0,r1+1):
 left=any(rr==r and cc<c0 for rr,cc in markers)
 right=any(rr==r and cc>c1 for rr,cc in markers)
 if not left:
  for c in range(c0): g[r][c]=2
 if not right:
  for c in range(c1+1,W): g[r][c]=2
# vertical extensions
for c in range(c0,c1+1):
 above=any(cc==c and rr<r0 for rr,cc in markers)
 below=any(cc==c and rr>r1 for rr,cc in markers)
 if not above:
  for r in range(r0): g[r][c]=2
 if not below:
  for r in range(r1+1,H): g[r][c]=2
for r,c in markers: g[r][c]=1
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
